name: readability-gate
description: A Stop hook that checks the final message of each turn reads on its own for an owner who reads nothing else: no restating recent final messages, no hard-to-read phrasing, and no names or numbers left unexplained. A failing message goes back for a rewrite, at most twice per turn. Fails open with a visible warning. Claude Code only. No MCP server, no skills.

hooks.statusMessage: Checking the reply reads without context...
